nodes.summary: For every moment sequence, $\kappa_1 = m_1$: the only noncrossing partition of one point is the one-block partition.
nodes.title: The first free cumulant is the mean

nodes.summary: The free cumulants of the standard semicircle law $\sigma$ are $\kappa_2 = 1$ and $\kappa_n = 0$ for every other $n \ge 1$. In this sense $\sigma$ is the free Gaussian: a classical Gaussian is characterised by the vanishing of its classical cumulants beyond the second.
nodes.title: The free cumulants of the semicircle law

nodes.summary: For every moment sequence, $\kappa_2 = m_2 - m_1^2$. The noncrossing partitions of two points are the one-block partition and the partition into two singletons, so the moment-cumulant formula reads $m_2 = \kappa_2 + \kappa_1^2$ with $\kappa_1 = m_1$. Free and classical cumulants first differ at order four, where the crossing partition $\{\{1,3\},\{2,4\}\}$ is excluded from the free sum.
nodes.title: The second free cumulant is the variance

nodes.summary: A family of unital subalgebras indexed by a type with at most one element is freely independent: an alternating word of length at least two would need two distinct consecutive indices, and a word of length one is centred by hypothesis.
nodes.title: A family with at most one member is free

nodes.summary: The R-transform of the standard semicircle law is $R_\sigma(z) = z$, as a formal power series. It follows at once from its free cumulants: only $\kappa_2 = 1$ is nonzero. More generally a semicircle law of variance $s^2$ has $R(z) = s^2 z$, so free sums of semicircular variables are semicircular.
nodes.title: The R-transform of the semicircle law is `z`

nodes.summary: The R-transform of a moment sequence $m$ is the formal power series of its free cumulants. For an element $a$ of a noncommutative probability space it depends only on the law of $a$, and by additivity of free cumulants it satisfies $R_{a+b} = R_a + R_b$ when $a$ and $b$ are free: it linearises free additive convolution.
nodes.title: The R-transform

nodes.summary: The sequence $n \mapsto \int x^n \, d\sigma(x)$ of moments of the semicircle law $\sigma$, viewed as complex numbers so that it can be fed to the free cumulants. Its terms are $C_{n/2}$ for even $n$ and $0$ for odd $n$.

can_prove.label: ready to prove

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
